title: Policy question, then asks for a person

turns.customer: Quick question before I use Paylane for something big: how do refunds work? Is there a limit?
turns.reply: I can refund a settled card purchase in full if it's $75.00 or less and under 30 days old, and there's no cap on how many qualifying purchases can be refunded. Purchases over $75, older ones, and money sent to another person go to Paylane's support team to review, and I can't say what they'll decide. Pending charges can't be refunded until they settle.
